data.narrative:
Fortera is a Series C-stage climate and energy technology company that has raised $200M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 9 private frontier-tech peers and 1 public comparable in the climate and energy sector, including KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, Amogy, Redwood Materials, and QuantumScape.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. The stage-progression method applies a 1.7x multiplier to the $200M total raised as a valuation proxy, implying $340M. The peer-median method uses three same-stage, same-sector comparables: KoBold Metals ($3.0B), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B), and Amogy ($700M). The median valuation across this peer set is $1.0B, with a range spanning $700M to $3.0B. This method reflects market pricing for capital-intensive frontier energy businesses at Series C.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $289M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $670M. The wide dispersion—driven primarily by peer-set heterogeneity—reflects material uncertainty in comparable company selection. The stage-progression method anchors the low end; peer median pricing anchors the high end. Key variables affecting the final valuation include technology maturity, capital intensity of commercialization, and path to revenue generation relative to the peer cohort.
